name: github-projects
description: GitHub Projects (v2) integration — list projects, inspect project items, add draft issues, and update item status via the GitHub GraphQL API.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: GitHub Projects (v2) boards, items, and status fields

fields.label: Personal Access Token
fields.helpText: GitHub PAT with project (and repo) scope.

tools.name: projects.list
tools.description: List GitHub Projects (v2) owned by an organization or user.

owner.description: Organization or user login that owns the projects

ownerType.description: Whether owner is an organization or a user (default organization)

tools.name: projects.get_items
tools.description: List items in a project (v2), including the linked issue/PR title and state.

owner.description: Organization or user login that owns the project

ownerType.description: Whether owner is an organization or a user (default organization)

number.description: Project number (as shown in the project URL)

tools.name: projects.add_draft_issue
tools.description: Add a draft issue to a project (v2).

tools.name: projects.update_item_status
tools.description: Set a single-select field value (e.g. Status) on a project item.

itemId.description: Project item node id, e.g. PVTI_xxx

fieldId.description: Single-select field node id, e.g. PVTSSF_xxx
